title: Diana after Diana: How her story kept changing long after her death
summary_full: Diana Frances Spencer, known as Princess Diana, remains a significant figure even after her tragic death. Various individuals and institutions construct different portrayals of her character and life experiences. Her brother Charles Spencer recently published a memoir that reflects on her legacy and relationships. Diana's influence persists, shaping identities and resonating in communities around the world.
